body.name: Observable-compressed rational-grid inner body and outer inflation
body.construction:
For each \(H\in\{F_\kappa,F_\infty\}\), form \(\mathcal G_{H,L}=\{q\in\Delta(H):Lq_f\in\mathbb Z\text{ for every }f\in H\}\), set \(\mathcal C_{H,L}=\operatorname{conv}v(\mathcal G_{H,L})\), and inflate this inner body by \([-e_{H,L},e_{H,L}]^m\), where
\[
 e_{H,L}=\min\left\{1,\frac{2(\min\{|H|,m\}-1)}{L}\right\}.
\]
The notation is evaluated separately with \(H=F_\kappa\) and \(H=F_\infty\).
